title: Biomass component areas (initial vs final cell)
caption: Voronoi treemap of biomass components, area proportional to mass, initial vs final cell.
interpretation: Each tile's area is proportional to that component's mass; protein dominates, followed by metabolites, rRNA and lipid. The initial and final panels are nearly identical, showing biomass composition is conserved as the cell grows and divides.
simulations: 2-seed x 2-gen wild-type baseline ensemble (showcase2-baseline-full), Ray-parallel, XArray/zarr + parquet emit.
